# DOG (Dots Of Games)

> Zero-dependency JavaScript library and CC0 collection of pixel-art game sprites. Sprites are text art painted with color ramps, so every sprite can be recolored to any material or hex color, combined, resized and exported in one call. Includes a character maker (2.7 million combinations of bodies, hats and held items), 4-direction walk cycles, attack/hit/heal/level-up/cast/death animations in 5 elements, 500+ procedural game effects (80 designs: explosions, magic, weapon slashes, projectiles, seamless weather, status overlays, crits, meteors; any color, any size), 66 sound effects made by code (attack sounds per weapon, hits, coins, magic, jingles, seamless loops; WAV export and browser playback), and game packs (sprite sheet + Aseprite/Phaser JSON + Godot SpriteFrames). Everything can be delivered for an 8, 16, 32 or 64 px tile grid (`{ grid: 32 }`; effects are redrawn natively, sprites converted with outline-preserving halving or Scale2x).

Import in a browser with no install: `import { dog } from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/olebangpad/dog@main/src/index.js'`.
Art is CC0 (public domain); code is MIT.

## Docs

- [Skill / quick reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olebangpad/dog/main/skills/dog/SKILL.md): setup, rules for crisp pixel art, the whole API, recipes for a playable game and for engine exports
- [Sprite catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olebangpad/dog/main/skills/dog/catalog.md): every sprite id, its size, frames and variants
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olebangpad/dog/main/README.md): overview and showcase

## Examples

- [Canvas starter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olebangpad/dog/main/templates/canvas/index.html): a one-file top-down game, no build step
- [Phaser starter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olebangpad/dog/main/templates/phaser/index.html): DOG game packs loaded with load.aseprite
- [Demo game source](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olebangpad/dog/main/web/quest.js): collisions, enemies, pickups, HUD
- [Playable demo](https://olebangpad.github.io/dog/game.html), [character maker](https://olebangpad.github.io/dog/#maker), [effects gallery](https://olebangpad.github.io/dog/fx.html) and [sounds](https://olebangpad.github.io/dog/sfx.html)
